description: This is a shell script that performs automated tests for a CVS to Git import process. It sets up CVS repositories, modules, imports, updates, and verifies revisions through a sequence of test cases.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for prerequisites needed to run the tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with optional tags and commands.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares files or outputs to verify correctness.

methods.name: test_cmp_branch_tree
methods.description: Specialized comparison for branch trees in version control.
